> Clunkey Rover is a small autonomous robot designed to explore robotics, embedded electronics, mechanical engineering, and CAD. The robot will use an ESP32 as its main controller, two geared motors for movement, and an ultrasonic distance sensor to detect objects in front of it. When the robot detects an obstacle, it will stop, turn, and continue moving in a different direction. I will design the robot's chassis in CAD, including the motor mounts, sensor mount, electronics platform, and battery compartment. I want the design to be compact, functional, and easy to modify as I learn more about the hardware. This project is inspired by my experience on a FIRST Robotics team and my interest in mechanical engineering and robotics. The name Clunkey Rover is inspired by Clunkey, a robotics mascot that became meaningful to my team. I want this project to be a way to continue building and experimenting with robotics while learning how mechanical parts, electronics, sensors, and programming work together in one complete system.
